tools.name: get_workflow_guide
tools.description: How to drive Koppar end to end, and the instructions for each stage you do yourself: "research" (part research and the dossier), "synthesis" (writing the SKiDL schematic), "review" (design review), "board" (the board plan). Read the stage guide before doing that stage.

tools.name: create_design
tools.description: Start a new design from the user's brief (what the board must do, its interfaces, power, size and constraints). Returns the design_id every other tool takes and the web_url where the user follows the design. Uses no generation quota: the work is done by you.

tools.name: list_designs
tools.description: The user's designs, newest first, including ones made in the web app (an agent can continue those too) and board workspaces (kind "board workspace"). With trashed, the designs in the trash instead (deleted, restorable for 7 days).

tools.name: delete_design
tools.description: Move a design (or a board workspace) to the trash: it leaves list_designs and the web app, and restore_design brings it back for 7 days, after which it is removed for good. permanent removes it, its files and its session right away. Refused while a run on it is in progress. The CLI: `koppar delete <

tools.name: restore_design
tools.description: Put a deleted design back from the trash (within 7 days of delete_design).

tools.name: get_design
tools.description: Where a design stands: the brief, the schematic (accepted or the last blocking error, ERC, part and net counts, submissions), the board run, the readable files, and the next step.

tools.name: search_kicad_symbol
tools.description: Search KiCad's standard symbol libraries for parts whose name contains a substring. Use this whenever you are not 100% sure the (library, name) pair you're about to pass to Part(...) exists. Always prefer the package-suffixed variant the search returns over a generic name. tools.description: Apply SEARCH/REPLACE patches to your latest script and re-run every check, as submit_circuit does. tools.name: get_review_packet
tools.description: Everything a design review needs in one text: the brief, the dossier, circuit.py and the compiled connectivity (every net with every pin and its function), with the reviewer instructions. Review it yourself and fix blockers with edit_circuit.

tools.name: get_board_context
tools.description: What the board plan is decided from: the computed minimum board, BOARD STATS (pad density, fine-pitch parts, fanout), the parts and nets, board instructions the user gave, and the plan schema with its rules. Needs an accepted schematic.

tools.name: start_board

tools.name: get_bom
tools.description: The live-priced BOM: each line with references, value, footprint, the chosen offer (seller, part number, MPN, price, stock, match quality), alternatives and totals. refresh asks the sellers again (tens of seconds).

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_workflow_guide, get_review_packet, upload_board, get_downloads · Private data: delete_design, get_design, search_kicad_symbol, get_kicad_symbol, create_custom_symbol, add_custom_footprint, edit_circuit, read_design_file, get_board_status, get_fab_status, upload_board, get_downloads, set_design_rules, cleanup_board, add_project_files · Public sink: submit_circuit, send_order_to_provider, upload_board, check_net_rules, couple_pairs, board_census · Destructive: delete_design, get_design, edit_circuit, start_board, get_board_status, set_design_rules, set_keepouts, check_physics, set_zones, prune_vias, route_board, ripup_routing, add_project_files, stamp_silkscreen, tie_rail_pads, bridge_islands, tidy_copper, polish_vias, couple_pairs, run_drc.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_workflow_guide, get_review_packet, upload_board, get_downloads · Private data: delete_design, get_design, search_kicad_symbol, get_kicad_symbol, create_custom_symbol, add_custom_footprint, edit_circuit, read_design_file, get_board_status, get_fab_status, upload_board, get_downloads, set_design_rules, cleanup_board, add_project_files · Public sink: submit_circuit, send_order_to_provider, upload_board, check_net_rules, couple_pairs, board_census · Destructive: delete_design, get_design, edit_circuit, start_board, get_board_status, set_design_rules, set_keepouts, check_physics, set_zones, prune_vias, route_board, ripup_routing, add_project_files, stamp_silkscreen, tie_rail_pads, bridge_islands, tidy_copper, polish_vias, couple_pairs, run_drc

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
